text: Test 1: the Architect moved the release of tasknote 1.0 to 2026-12-20.

The app stores its data in one SQLite file in the user's data folder, with no server (D1, `@decided`). It runs on Node.js 24 with no runtime dependencies (D5, `@decided`). Export is JSON (D2, changed by the user), and there is no sync between machines in version 1.0 (D3, `@decided` by the user).
